beforeShellExecution.command: { command -v rtok >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec rtok hook PreToolUse --host cursor; [ -x "$HOME/.ketch/bin/rtok" ] && exec "$HOME/.ketch/bin/rtok" hook PreToolUse --host cursor; true; exit 0; }

afterShellExecution.command: { command -v rtok >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec rtok hook PostToolUse --host cursor; [ -x "$HOME/.ketch/bin/rtok" ] && exec "$HOME/.ketch/bin/rtok" hook PostToolUse --host cursor; true; exit 0; }

sessionStart.command: { command -v rtok >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec rtok hook SessionStart --host cursor; [ -x "$HOME/.ketch/bin/rtok" ] && exec "$HOME/.ketch/bin/rtok" hook SessionStart --host cursor; true && printf '%s' '{"additional_context":"rtok is not installed; run ketch install pyrlyn/rtok to enable it."}'; exit 0; }
